identity.title: List of Pokémon Adventures Scarlet & Violet volumes

leadText: The of Pokémon Adventures is being separately collected into mini-volumes by Shogakukan in Japan. The volume releases began on February 28, 2024 . Once the ends in the regular volumes, the Scarlet & Violet arc will be properly collected in that format as well.
